title: The Water Run
description: The settlement's well is failing. Someone has to drive the old tanker to the reservoir at Glass Lake and back, through raider country, before the summer heat arrives.

chapterOutlines.title: Glass Lake
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out why the reservoir went quiet.

scene.location: The motor yard of Haven settlement, before dawn
scene.summary: The tanker coughs awake. Half the settlement has come to watch, and nobody is saying what everyone is thinking.

openThreads: Why did Glass Lake stop trading?

npcs.name: Tobias Grell
npcs.description: Keeps the tanker alive with wire, prayer and spare parts from three different decades.
goals: Bring the tanker home in one piece
abilities: Can fix any engine with what is lying around

npcs.description: Remembers the world before the Collapse and refuses to romanticize it.
